summary_he: סקיל לאסטרטגיה ויצירת תוכן לרשתות חברתיות (LinkedIn, X, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, Telegram) עם הנחיות לכתיבה, קרוסלות, וידאו קצר וניטור שיח. רובו הנחיות טקסטואליות בלבד. הסיכון בינוני-נמוך: הוא כולל פקודות curl ל-API ציבוריים (Reddit, Hacker News, Bluesky, YouTube) ושימוש בדפדפן עם סשן מחובר של המשתמש ל-LinkedIn ול-X, אך מדגיש שאין לפרסם אוטומטית בלי אישור.

concerns.issue: Instructs the agent to drive an authenticated, persistent browser session (dev-browser/Playwright) on the user's LinkedIn and X accounts to read feeds. This is legitimate for the stated purpose, but gives the agent access to logged-in accounts. Mitigation: the skill says the user reviews and posts manually and should not auto-post.

Runs curl requests against public endpoints (reddit.com, hn.algolia.com, public.api.bsky.app, youtube.com RSS, user-configured blog feeds). Fetched content is a prompt-injection surface; the skill explicitly says to treat it as untrusted data.
Suggests installing jq and libxml2-utils via brew/apt. These are standard tools and installation is optional.

Suggests publishing through third-party scheduling tools (Typefully, Buffer, etc.) via MCP or API, which would need the user's own credentials. It requires drafts first and explicit approval before anything is scheduled.
